name: opencode-go-watch
description: Cloudflare Worker that semantically monitors OpenCode Go usage limits and sends rich Telegram diffs.

scripts.validate: npm run check && npm run typecheck && npm test

TELEGRAM_BOT_TOKEN.description: Telegram Bot API token. Store as an encrypted Worker secret; never commit it.

ADMIN_TOKEN.description: Long random secret protecting /status, /check, /telegram/setup, and baseline controls.
